title: Security Scanning Exception Configuration
description: Documented false positives and reviewed security exceptions for secret and dependency scanning.

secretExceptions.reason: Simulated secret patterns used strictly in unit tests for negative security scanner testing.

dependencyExceptions.reason: Fastify Content-Type header tab character validation bypass.
dependencyExceptions.mitigation: Implemented explicit onRequest header validation hook in apps/iot-gateway rejecting tab characters (	) with 400 Bad Request.
HTTP2 protocol disabled in Fastify server configuration; only standard HTTP/1.1 REST endpoints exposed.

dependencyExceptions.reason: Vite server.fs.deny bypass on Windows alternate paths.
dependencyExceptions.mitigation: Vitest dev test runner only; omitted from production deployment.

dependencyExceptions.reason: Vitest UI server arbitrary file read and execution.
dependencyExceptions.mitigation: Vitest UI server not enabled or exposed; test runner executed only via headless CLI.
